title: Rust: state machine
description: Implement desync state machine for Rust. Acceptance: Consistent with Python implementation.
close_reason: Implemented DesyncFSM (3-state: Synced/Desynced/Recovering) and CcpFSM (4-state: Unjoined/Joined/Drift/Recover) in rust/lichen-core/src/desync.rs. Matches Python implementation in python/src/lichen/timing/sfn.py. Includes constants, initial_startup_delay, and 23 unit tests.
